notes.title: [REPLAY] Major Update livestream
notes.notes:
Come and watch Chris and Romain to discover the fresh Major Update of BattleCore Arena!

Your favorite free-to-play platformer shooter has been on since June and you’ve been asking us for two main things: controller support and a faster way to play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/d91a6e320e570dd9414964f0bb4c884e9ca1853c.png

Quick Play
You want to jump into the action? Fast? Quick Play is there for you! Join the first game available across our two game modes and compete against other players:

Backup: Be the last team standing in this 3V3 Team Death Match where you share lives with your teammates.
Q-Ball: Enter the highly competitive Q-Ball mode, where teamwork is key to catch and keep the Q-Ball to lead your team to victory.

Controller support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/55a98f707d008d6648d78604328e868ede513928.jpg
You’re not a mouse and keyboard addict? No problem! BattleCore Arena is now compatible with Xbox controllers.

A few options will be available:

 Joysticks deadzone (slider)
 X & Y sensitivities (slider)
 Horizontal & vertical axis inversion (on/off)
 Aim friction (on/off): when controlling the camera, cross hair will slow down when passing on a target.
 Aim response curve (Classic, Linear, Fine aim, Steady, High Velocity)



New equipment
But wait there’s more! We’re also adding three new equipments to enhance your gameplay experience:

NOVA: Finally, a new weapon to compete against the ORION! Load your projectiles to fire powerful shots.
Black Hole: Playing with gravity is now within your reach! Launch a black hole that draws in any enemies within its range and shoot at them when they’re trapped.
Synchronization: After a few times using your ability, you will be able to use it twice in a row!
 

And now, time to get back to the (BattleCore) Arena!

notes.title: 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello players,

Welcome to our new 0.2.1 hotfix!

This is a very small one with a few party system improvements.

Playing together as a party and using the matchmaking system is now fixed, ensuring all players are invited and can search for a game. 

Best of luck out there! 
The BatleCore Arena Team

notes.title: 0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello players,

Welcome to our new 0.1.6 hotfix!
Blette has moved again, will you be able to find her now?

QUICKPLAY
Our matchmaking has been reworked into a quickplay set-up. To search for a match, you will no longer need to select a specific game mode queue. Instead, the matchmaking will look for the first available match regardless of the game mode. The "PLAY" UI has been modified to accommodate the reworked matchmaking feature.
 
This also meant that the Q-Ball game mode needed to be been taken off the progression system. If you already unlocked Q-Ball, you will be compensated with 100 Battlecoins when you log in.


BALANCING
The Invisibility has been fixed, resulting in a improvement of the ability:

 The Jump visual effect is now invisible for enemies if you're invisible
 If someone is targetting you with another ability while you're invisible, the related visual effects will also be invisible (Shield Healing, Blast, Flashbang)

Time to show your sneaky playstyle! 😼
 
IMPROVEMENTS

 Players will now always match against AIs on their first match after completing the tutorial. This is part of our current effort to improve the player onboarding.
 We improved device detection in the Option/Audio Tab
 Bots can now replace players who left an on-going game. That way, it will always be a 3v3 match
 Blette’s image has been improved

 
BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where a Custom Game would not be considered an Ongoing Game
 Fixed an issue where players wouldn't be able to join a Custom Game mode as a Party
 Fixed a small issue with Custom Game mode icons
 Fixed an issue where players could hit through surfaces using explosive type weapons
 Fixed an issue where the Regeneration module visual effect did not stop when it should
 Fixed the sound effect when using an XP boost in the menu
 Fixed an issue where Season pass specific challenges would not progress after purchasing a Season Pass


See you in the arena!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.5 08/08/2024
notes.notes:
Blette got scared and moved to a safer position, where you won't be able to find her.
 
Updates

UI

 Player names are no longer offset after taking a photo on the podium.
 The countdown sound is now correctly synchronized with UI.
 The player card image was resized and an XP icon was added.

Bug fixes

 The launching cannon is no longer stuck in a single direction.
 On Singularity, a missing collision with a floating island was added.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.4 01/08/2024
notes.notes:
This week we did several changes to weapon balancing and player progression/XP gain, in addition to further improvements and bug fixes.

Balancing

 The Vortex-5 and Pulser weapons received some balancing tweaks:

VORTEX-5 Buff
Shield Damage : 11 -> 13
Ammunition regeneration per second : 2 -> 3
 
PULSER Nerf
Number of projectiles : 8 -> 6
Shield damage : 8 -> 9
Impulse : 38 -> 41

 Player progression was tweaked:
 XP earned at the end of a game is now doubled
 Your first game will give you level 2 of Core Mastery and Equipment Masteries
 Coop vs AI now provides the same amount of XP

UI/UX

 The damage direction indicators have been revamped
 A "disable motion blur" button was added to the option/graphics settings
 A "+" button was added to the main menu to more easily add friends to your party


Audio

 Some Audio tweaks and improvements


Bug Fixes

 The game window not being minimized when using ALT+TAB shortcut or WIN button in fullscreen mode was fixed
 The "player reported" confirmation pop up staying on screen after the game ended is now disappearing correctly
 Scroll boxes (season pass, equipment, career) have been fixed
 Players' names are now being correctly displayed in the notifications when leaving a party


Other

 Removed FFA challenges for now

notes.title: Patch notes 0.1.3 04/07/2024
notes.notes:
An audio quality pass was made and a lot of changes implemented. Go and amuse your ears and see if you can hear a difference!
 
UI
Minor tweaks to colours, icons and buttons
 
Optimization
Performance increases for high spec settings
 
Bug fixes
It is no longer possible to get stuck in a false cannon in the tutorial
In Q-Ball, getting flashed will now keep you from targeting an ally with a pass

notes.title: Patch notes 27/06/2024
notes.notes:
A massively requested feature is now live; the selected weapon, ability and module will now stay chosen for your next match.
 
Your chosen audio device will also be saved if your game is restarted, and settings will no longer reset to default if you change your language.
 
Menu: 
Reduced the time of the animation to go into customization mode
 
Customization:
The colour of your core light will now stay correctly chosen.
 
Bots:
Bot names have been updated.
 
Audio: 
The disconnect sound from players on the podium will now play correctly and there are several new sounds for weapons and abilities, check them out!

notes.title: Patch Notes 20-06-2024
notes.notes:
General: 

 Several stability fixes
 Players are no longer able to create groups bigger than intended
 Crosshair colour can now be customized


Balancing: 

 COOP VS AI will no longer give as much XP


Maps: 

 The invisible rock on the Trinity map is now visible and the armor beneath the redgrid has been removed
 Skipping the intro map and using the launch canon quickly will no longer cause a lag spike on the Singularity map
 Some parts in the Tutorial map and the Vertigo map had unintended areas that would make you jump, they have been removed
 Removed everything that was outside the redgrid on the Training map

notes.title: HOTFIX - 06/07/2024
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001411/53b20a05c39ac47a927470fcea686c026bde5bb0.png

FIXED


 [ONLINE] The "error" list now has "warnings" instead of "errors"
 [GAMEFLOW] Leaving during the map intro cinematic will no longer prevent the game from launching
 [REWARD] First wave customization items are now added
 [GAME MODE] FFA has been temporarily desactivated in custom mode so we can fix it
 [PROGRESSION] Some players were unable to go past level 4, they should now be able to do so
 [UI] XP levels in the menu UI will now display correctly

 
INVESTIGATING

 [MAP] A lag spike will happen on Singularity if a player is skipping the intro cinematic
